system.description: • Effect: Every hit against your marked prey deals an extra weapon damage die and ignores its Resistance. It combines with Hunter's Tricks and with the Favoured Enemy die. This is the Ranger's exception to one damage die a round.

rules.value: Relentless Hunter: every hit on your marked prey deals an extra weapon damage die and ignores its resistance (on top of Favoured Enemy's die, K195).
